cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Civil Designer role in Toowoomba, which I saw on SEEK. Your advert says the role delivers practical civil designs for roads, intersections, subdivisions, drainage and floodways across regional Queensland, working alongside your engineering team.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. In it I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. It also gave me a practical understanding of constructability. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020, I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Toowoomba for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a call to talk about the role?

Marc Masarate
